text:
elaine (PM): starting thread for a rollout plan for the "surge governor" feature — aims: graceful throttling/eviction when cross-region capacity is tight. want canary plan, flag surfaces, opt-outs, and rollback ladder.

sam (eng): TL;DR: runtime exposes policy layer + per-tenant score. flags must be hierarchical (global, region, tenant). canaries need to run both normal and degraded paths.

maya (sre): we need a degradation matrix and explicit reason codes in responses. propose bands: normal / degraded (cached/KV responses) / evicted (fallback model). SLA implications must be documented.

tom (ml): caution on quality cliffs when switching model variants. recommend shadowing smaller variants and gating by eval delta (<2% on key metrics) before active failover.

jordan (cs): customers want opt-out and notification hooks when demoted. request per-tenant holdback flag and webhook contract.

sam (eng): flag design: keys like surge_governor.enabled, surge_governor.mode, surge_governor.holdbacks[]. support TTLs for temporary holds. modes: auto, manual, shadow.

elaine (PM): draft phases:
- Phase 0: internal dogfood + metrics (2w)
- Phase 1: invite-only tenants (5%) with webhook + manual kill-switch
- Phase 2: soft enable for 20% traffic with auto-rollback gates
- Phase 3: GA with tiered defaults
thoughts on timing?

maya (sre): timings OK but add preflight shadow run 48h across regions to check KV cache hit regressions. add circuit-breaker: if error rate >0.5% over 10m, auto-rollback.

sam (eng): canary batch plan: 1k requests/region every 15m, measure lat/err/quality, require 3 stable batches to promote.

tom (ml): log per-sample model variant and attach mini-eval per tenant for continuous quality checks.

alex (sales): include expected unit-cost delta in console and webhook so customers know pricing when demoted.

jordan (cs): enterprise contract needs opt-out, emergency override, and audit logs. legal wants auditability for private deployments.

elaine (PM): decision proposals:
1) default auto-govern for free/hosted tiers, enterprise defaults to manual.
2) expose per-tenant holdbacks + webhook notifications.
3) rollback ladder: soft-disable -> shadow -> full-disable -> model rollback.
vote/thumbs up or suggest edits.

sam (eng): +1, add granular flag to disable auto-bump for model variants.

maya (sre): +1, require ops-approved ticket for manual override >24h.

tom (ml): +1, gate on latency + quality.

jordan (cs): +1, will draft customer FAQ and notify AMs.

deploy-bot: staging deploy scheduled Thu 03:00 UTC. CI passed for feature branch.

elaine (PM): action items:
- sam: flag schema + API (ETA Wed)
- maya: SLO thresholds + rollback scripts (ETA Fri)
- tom: tenant mini-evals + logging (ETA Fri)
- jordan: customer FAQ + opt-out flow (ETA Mon)
- alex: pricing blurb for console/webhook (ETA Mon)
- eng ops: plan staging canary run (Thu)

sam (eng): example flag YAML:
```
surge_governor:
  enabled: true
  mode: auto  # auto | manual | shadow
  level: safe  # safe | aggressive
  tenant_overrides:
    - tenant_id: t-123
      holdback: true
      ttl: 86400
```

maya (sre): rollback log snippet: ROLLBACK_REASON=surge-governor:error_rate>0.5% — surface in telemetry/audit.

elaine (PM): I'll turn this into a short playbook and link in shiproom. any objections? otherwise Ph0 starts tomorrow. :rocket:
